reasoning_content: sudo not installed. Use runuser/su. Let me use `runuser -u qisutu -- env QISUTU_HOME=/opt/qisutu perl ...`. Also need to detach properly with setsid/nohup.

action.command:
runuser -u qisutu -- env QISUTU_HOME=/opt/qisutu /usr/bin/perl /opt/qisutu/bin/qisutu-daemon.pl --sleep 3 --max-jobs 100 > /tmp/daemon.log 2>&1 &
sleep 8
pgrep -af "qisutu-daemon.pl" | grep -v pgrep; echo "--- log"; tail -30 /tmp/daemon.log
